name: Keio Corporation
summary: Keio Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in transportation, real estate, and merchandise sales businesses in Japan. It operates through five segments: Transportation, Real Estate, Hotel, Construction and Equipment, and Lifestyle Services. The company offers passenger transport services, such as trains and buses; hotel services; and building management, construction, and civil engineering services. It is also involved in real estate leasing; and retail businesses focusing on lifestyle-related services.
